pass_meta.pass: Location scoping, with a job seeded at each Location

C45151.observed: Proved with data seeded for it. One job was created at each of the two Locations on this test site - S-17717 at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and S-17718 at Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Standing at Heavy Duty, search returns that Location's own job S-17717 and does NOT return S-17718, which belongs to the other Location. The job it does return is the positive control: the search is working, and it is leaving out only the record that belongs somewhere else.

C45152.observed: The Location shown in the app never changes for this sign-in, so a before-and-after cannot be read. Six ways were tried: the change behind the screen, the Change Location item in the profile menu, a full page reload after the change, three readings there-and-back-and-there, signing in as a staff member whose own Location is the second one, and finally a job seeded at each Location so the data itself would show the difference. The app stays on Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 throughout.
C45152.not_observed: Whether search refreshes when the Location actually changes.
C45152.todo: What needs to be done: one sign-in whose Location genuinely moves, or a staff account tied to Staging Lethbridge - 4310 that keeps that Location when signed in as. With that, this takes minutes. The jobs are already seeded at both Locations and waiting. This blocks nothing else - every other check on this suite is finished.
